# MASV

> > MASV is a cloud-based large file transfer platform designed for media and entertainment professionals, offering fast, secure delivery with integrations for post-production workflows.

MASV provides store-and-forward file transfer technology with features like 10Gbps speeds, MASV Portals for client uploads, MASV API for developers, and integrations with tools like Frame.io, Microsoft 365, and NAS systems. The platform serves video production, post-production, broadcast, and marketing teams requiring reliable transfer of large media files.

## Key Topics

- MASV
